root_idea.summary: The root centers on diminution or loss: a shortfall in what is due, especially a shortfall of fidelity that becomes betrayal.
root_idea.development: From loss or diminution, the root develops the sense of failing a trust or covenant and extends in derived usages to impairment, gradual wasting, failure, suspected betrayal, and attempted betrayal.

senses.definition: To betray or be unfaithful to a person, trust, covenant, or confidence.
senses.usage_conditions: The use is not limited to property; it may concern an entrusted matter, a covenant, or a relationship of trust.

senses.definition: To seek, entertain, or move toward betrayal; to contemplate betraying rather than necessarily complete the betrayal.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction with oneself, the Form VIII expression describes an incipient or attempted inclination toward betrayal, distinguished from completed خِيَانَة.

senses.definition: A treacherous person, party, or act; treachery viewed as an instance of unfaithfulness.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passage concerning a group, the feminine form may refer to a treacherous group or person; it is also explained as a verbal noun meaning treachery.

senses.definition: A furtive or concealed glance, eye signal, or intentionally contracted look.
senses.usage_conditions: Occurs in the construction خَائِنَةُ الأَعْيُنِ, referring to a surreptitious look or an eye gesture concealing an intention.

senses.definition: An unfaithful or treacherous person; one who betrays a trust or confidence.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quranic occurrences are masculine plural forms used substantivally for people characterized by betrayal.

senses.definition: Highly or habitually treacherous; greatly and repeatedly unfaithful.
senses.usage_conditions: An intensive epithet, functioning adjectivally or substantivally for one characterized by pronounced unfaithfulness.

senses.definition: Betrayal: a secret breach of a trust, covenant, or right; unfaithfulness contrary to what is due.
senses.usage_conditions: The term is contrasted with أَمَانَةٌ and is not restricted to property; it may concern a covenant, trust, or other entrusted matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loss or diminution caused to another; a shortfall in what is due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader lexical explanation of the root's primary signification, distinct from the Quranic covenant-betrayal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fail or prove ineffective; to be unable to carry out an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in expressions for an ineffective sword and for limbs unable to perform their function.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break off or become severed from something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested of a well-rope becoming detached from the bucket.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To alter someone's condition for the worse; to bring hardship or deterioration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of time, fortune, enjoyment, or anything that changes a person's condition from ease to difficulty or harm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attribute betrayal or treachery to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Form II usage assigns the characterization of unfaithfulness to another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek to expose someone's treachery or wrongful conduct; to suspect or accuse that person of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may involve investigating or displaying a person's betrayal, lapse, or wrong action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To diminish, waste, impair, or take away gradually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a right, an object, or bodily substance being reduced little by little.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend to repeatedly or return to someone or something time after time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported usage associated with a variant of تَخَوَّلَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inn, caravanserai, or lodging house for travelers and merchants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An Arabicized loanword for a building or establishment where travelers, merchants, and their goods are received.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate loanword usage reported alongside the lodging-house sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shopkeeper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Arabicized loanword usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A title of honor for a ruler, governor, or man of rank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later title used among the Tartars, Turks, and Persians.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weakness or diminished strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended usage, including physical weakness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Languor or weakness in the gaze.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative bodily usage describing the eye or sight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pertaining to a merchants' caravanserai or lodging house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from خَانٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A table or stand on which food is placed and eaten.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is especially described as a table when food is upon it; the word is Arabicized from Persian.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended designation explained by the lion's treacherous character or languid gaze.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Time or fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended or figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The day on which provisions are exhausted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression seeking protection from that day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reported old name for Rabīʿ al-Awwal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The report is explicitly presented as doubtful by one authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare extended usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One to whom betrayal or treachery is attributed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial designation for a person accused or characterized as treacherous.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The inability of the legs is covered by the broader failure or inability sense.

cautions: The Form VIII Quranic usage is lexically distinguished from completed خِيَانَة: it describes an attempted or incipient movement toward betrayal in the cited construction.
The Quranic خَائِنَةٌ has more than one interpretation in the supplied evidence: a treacherous person or group, a verbal noun, and the furtive eye expression خَائِنَةُ الأَعْيُنِ.
The reported use of خَوَّانٌ for Rabīʿ al-Awwal is retained as a disputed Classical usage, not as a Quranic meaning.
